cross_session_pilot.verdict: negative for one follow-up question; build cost must be amortized over more sessions or questions

notes: Second-project correctness gate passes: all five independently authored questions were verified correct. Efficiency gate fails: the 8-record macro memory did not cover 4/5 questions, the answer run used 78 tools, and even the gap-filled q2 run was not cheaper or faster than cold. The two-session pilot was also negative for one follow-up. This project needs denser per-module memories and a multi-question workload before claiming a practical memory win.
